name: Contextual Relevance
description: The degree to which the continuation is relevant to the given context and interesting fact.

name: Factual Accuracy
description: The accuracy of the information provided in the continuation, including the correct use of the interesting fact.

name: Creativity
description: The originality and inventiveness of the continuation, including the creative use of the interesting fact.

name: Coherence
description: The logical flow and clarity of the continuation, ensuring it makes sense and is easy to follow.

name: Engagement
description: The ability of the continuation to captivate and engage the reader or listener, making them interested in the conversation.
